question: Compare Westrill Canal Office toll-receipt retention with Oakenford Survey Store completed-survey-record retention, including their exceptions.
answer:
[1] Westrill Canal Office toll receipts are retained for 10 months, unless an unresolved toll claim requires longer retention.

[2] Oakenford Survey Store completed survey records are retained for 20 months, unless an unresolved audit dispute requires longer retention.
